variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 'Let not the rebellious exalt themselves' renders either the qere qal יָרוּמוּ (rise up, be exalted) or the ketiv hiphil ירימו read reflexively (lift themselves up); the English has no italicized supply and no textual note on the verse, so nothing in the wording distinguishes the stems. Base qere fallback retained.
